unlockLines: Plastic fantastic, beta. That tiny card has more earning potential than your entire desk. Try not to get outperformed by a rectangle.
Credit cards unlocked. You bring the charm; I bring the machine that goes cha-ching. Finally, office music I can tolerate.
Call it premium customer service. I call it my next gold chain wearing a little plastic disguise. Very sophisticated shit.
Congratulations on joining the plastic economy. Your employee of the month trophy is also plastic. We are vertically integrated.
Four corners. One chip. More ambition than half this office. Show the card some respect, beta. It pays my bills.
